blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep vision systems remain vulnerable to corruption, occlusion, and distribution shift despite strong benchmark performance. Existing reliability methods typically evaluate uncertainty at individual time steps and do not explicitly model how a system progresses toward failure. We introduce Visual Tripwires , a predictive reliability framework that uses temporal instability in model behaviour to anticipate impending failure. Our central hypothesis is that predictive degradation develops progressively through measurable changes in latent representations, prediction trajectories, and attention structure. Visual Tripwires captures these changes using representation drift, prediction oscillation, trajectory curvature, and attention entropy. A lightweight tripwire predictor aggregates these signals over a temporal window to estimate the probability of failure within a future prediction horizon. Experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and progressive perturbation settings show that the proposed instability signals emerge before predictive degradation and provide earlier and more accurate failure warnings than conventional uncertainty estimation methods. These results demonstrate that temporal instability contains useful information about future model reliability and provides a practical basis for early warning in deep vision systems.
blocks.zh: 尽管基准业绩强劲,但深层次的愿景系统仍然容易受到腐败、排斥和分配转变的影响。 现有可靠性方法通常在个别时间步骤上评价不确定性,没有明确模拟系统如何走向失败。 我们引入了Visual Tripwires, 一个预测可靠性框架, 它利用时间不稳定 在模型行为 预测即将发生的故障。 我们的中心假设是,预测性退化通过潜在表达、预测轨迹和注意力结构的可测量变化而逐步发展。 视觉Tripwires利用表现漂移,预测振荡,轨迹曲率,以及注意力py来捕捉这些变化. 一个轻量级的绊线预测器在时间窗口上将这些信号汇总,以估计未来预测范围内的故障概率. 跨越多个数据集、架构和渐进扰动设置的实验表明,拟议的不稳定信号在预测退化之前就出现,并且比常规不确定性估计方法更早和更准确地提供故障警告。 这些结果表明,时间不稳定包含关于未来模型可靠性的有用信息,并为深视系统预警提供了实际依据。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep vision systems have achieved remarkable success across image classification, object detection, segmentation, tracking, and video understanding tasks [ 9 , 2 , 16 ] . Despite strong benchmark performance, they remain highly vulnerable to corruption, occlusion, and distribution shift [ 10 , 7 , 19 ] . In safety relevant settings such as content moderation or driving perception, this vulnerability is consequential: a model that fails silently can propagate an incorrect decision before a human has the chance to intervene.
blocks.zh: 深视系统在图像分类、物体探测、分片、跟踪和视频理解任务方面都取得了显著成功[9、2、16]。 尽管基准业绩良好,但它们仍然极易受到腐败、排斥和分配转移的影响[10、7、19]。 在安全相关环境下,如内容节制或驱动感知,这种脆弱性是必然的:在人类有机会干预之前,一个失败的模型可以无声地传播错误的决定。

blocks.en: Existing reliability methods, including calibration and out of distribution detection [ 8 , 13 , 11 ] , underlie selective prediction, where a model defers to human review once confidence falls below a threshold. However, these methods assess reliability independently at each time step and typically detect unreliability only after degradation has occurred, leaving little lead time for review before a failure propagates.
blocks.zh: 现有可靠性方法,包括校准和分发检测[8、13、11],是选择性预测的基础,即当信任低于阈值时,模型将服从人类审查。 然而,这些方法在每一阶段都独立评估可靠性,一般只在退化发生后才发现不可靠性,在失败蔓延之前,没有多少准备时间进行审查。

blocks.en: Complex dynamical systems often exhibit early warning signals prior to critical transitions, with increasing variance and structural disruption preceding failure [ 21 ] . Motivated by this, we treat failure in vision systems as a process rather than an isolated event, one that unfolds through instability in internal representation dynamics before it is visible in model outputs. This is supported by evidence that latent representations encode structural information about model behaviour [ 20 , 18 ] and are sensitive to distribution shift [ 24 , 23 ] , yet existing reliability methods rarely model this temporal evolution.
blocks.zh: 复杂的动态系统往往在关键过渡前显示预警信号,故障前差异和结构中断增加[21]. 以此为动机,我们把愿景系统中的失败视为一个进程,而不是一个孤立的事件,它通过内部代表动态的不稳定性展开,然后才能在模型产出中显现出来。 有证据表明,潜在表述编码了关于模型行为的结构信息[20,18],并且对分布转移[24,23]敏感,但现有的可靠性方法很少为这种时间演变提供模型。

blocks.en: We introduce Visual Tripwires , a framework that models the temporal evolution of latent representations, prediction trajectories, and attention structure to anticipate unreliable operating regimes before predictive collapse, providing lead time for human review. We define a family of instability signals, representation drift, prediction oscillation, latent trajectory curvature, and attention entropy, and aggregate them into a tripwire score that estimates the probability of future failure within a prediction horizon. This reframes reliability estimation as a temporal instability modeling problem, better suited to selective prediction under sustained perturbation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Visual Tripwires, 一个模拟潜在表达、预测轨迹和注意力结构时间演化的框架, 在预测崩溃前预测不可靠的操作系统, 为人类的审查提供筹备时间。 我们定义了不稳定信号, 表示漂移,预测振荡, 潜伏的轨迹曲率, 以及注意力的演化, 把它们集合成一个绊线计分, 估计未来在预测范围内失败的概率。 这种方法将可靠性估计重新定义为一个时间不稳定的模型问题,更适合于持续扰动下的选择性预测。

blocks.en: We evaluate our framework across multiple architectures, datasets, and progressive perturbation settings, including a driving scene dataset relevant to deployment. Instability signals consistently rise before predictive degradation, providing substantially longer early warning than conventional uncertainty estimation. While our experiments focus on benign corruption, the same signature, sustained deviation building over time, is also expected under adaptive or adversarial perturbation, motivating temporal instability modeling as a direction for robust, verifiable vision systems.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多个架构、数据集和渐进扰动设置,包括一个与部署有关的驱动场数据集,评估我们的框架。 在预测性退化之前,不稳定信号持续上升,提供比常规不确定性估计长得多的预警。 虽然我们的实验侧重于良性腐败,但是在适应性或对抗性的扰动下,同样的标志、持续的偏差逐渐形成,预计也会引起时间不稳定模式,成为强有力、可核查的愿景系统的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Reliability in deep vision has primarily been addressed through per instance uncertainty estimation. Maximum softmax probability [ 11 ] and temperature scaling [ 8 ] calibrate confidence for a single prediction; Monte Carlo dropout [ 3 ] and deep ensembles [ 13 ] approximate uncertainty through sampling; ODIN [ 14 ] refines confidence using input perturbations. All condition only on the current prediction, so they detect unreliability only once it is already visible in the output. Selective prediction builds on these scores to decide when a model should abstain or defer to human review [ 5 , 6 ] , but inherits the same limitation: deferral is triggered at the point of failure, not before it. Our framework targets exactly this gap, providing the lead time that selective prediction requires to be preventive rather than reactive.
blocks.zh: 深刻愿景中的可靠性主要通过逐例的不确定性估计来解决。 最大软最大概率[11]和温度缩放[8]校准单一预测的置信度; 蒙特卡洛退出[3]和深聚体[13]通过取样大致不确定; ODIN[14]利用输入扰动改进置信度. 所有条件都只以当前预测为条件,所以只有在输出中已经可见时,它们才会发现不可靠性. 选择性预测建立在这些分数的基础上,决定一个模型何时应该弃权或服从人类审查[5,6],但继承同样的限制: 推迟是在失败时触发的,而不是在它之前. 我们的框架正是针对这一差距的,它提供了有选择的预测需要预防而不是被动的准备时间。

blocks.en: Vision models degrade sharply under corruption and distribution shift [ 10 , 7 ] , and uncertainty estimates are known to remain poorly calibrated under exactly these conditions [ 19 ] . Test time adaptation methods such as Tent [ 24 ] and test time training [ 23 ] respond to this by updating model parameters online, treating representation instability as a fault to correct. We instead treat that instability as the signal itself, exploiting it to anticipate failure rather than to repair the model. This is grounded in evidence that latent representations carry structural information about generalization, typically probed through canonical correlation analysis [ 20 , 18 ] . Such analyses compare static snapshots of a trained network; we instead track the temporal evolution of a single network’s representations along a trajectory, converting a diagnostic tool into an online monitoring signal.
blocks.zh: 在腐败和分配转移[10、7]的情况下,远景模型急剧退化,据了解,在准确的这些条件下,不确定性估计数仍然不准确校准[19]。 腾讯[24]和测试时间训练[23]等测试时间适应方法对此做出响应,在线更新模型参数,将表现不稳定性视为纠正的过错. 相反,我们把这种不稳定作为信号本身,利用它来预测失败,而不是修复模型。 其依据是,有证据表明,潜在表述带有关于概括性的结构信息,通常通过犬类关联分析[20、18]进行探究。 这种分析比较了训练有素的网络的静态快照;我们转而跟踪单个网络在轨迹上的表现时间演变,将诊断工具转换成在线监测信号。

blocks.en: Detecting distributional change in streaming data is a long standing problem in statistics, addressed by methods such as the Page-Hinkley test, CUSUM, and adaptive windowing [ 4 ] . These operate on scalar output statistics and are agnostic to model internals. Our instability signals are model internal analogues of the same principle, computed over latent representations and attention structure rather than output metrics, and combined through a learned aggregation rather than a fixed statistical test. The underlying hypothesis, that systems display measurable irregularity before a critical transition, is established in complex systems research, where rising variance and oscillation are known to precede collapse in ecological, climate, and biological systems [ 21 ] . This principle has so far been applied to physical and biological dynamical systems; we apply it to the latent trajectory of a vision model under perturbation, treating predictive failure as the critical transition to be anticipated.
blocks.zh: 检测流数据的分配变化是统计中长期存在的问题,通过Page-Hinkley测试、CUSUM和适应性窗口[4]等方法加以解决。 这些功能在scalar输出统计上运行,对内部建模具有不可知性. 我们的不稳定信号是同一原则的模拟内部模型,计算出比潜在表示和注意结构,而不是输出指标,并通过一个学到的汇总而不是固定的统计测试加以合并。 在复杂的系统研究中确立了基本假设,即系统在关键过渡前表现出可测量的不规则性,据了解,在生态、气候和生物系统崩溃之前,差异和振荡正在增加[21]。 迄今为止,这一原则已应用于物理和生物动态系统;我们将其应用于扰动下视觉模型的潜在轨迹,将预测性故障视为预期的关键过渡。

blocks.en: Video anomaly detection identifies frames or segments that deviate from normal appearance or motion [ 15 , 22 ] , but targets anomalies in the scene, not instability in the model perceiving it. Our framework asks a different question: not whether the input is anomalous, but whether the model’s own response to it is becoming unstable, which we argue is the more direct signal of impending failure.
blocks.zh: 视频异常检测识别出偏离正常外观或运动的帧或片段[15,22],但针对的是场景中的异常,而不是模型感知到它的不稳定性. 我们的框架提出了一个不同的问题:不是输入是不正常的,而是模型本身对它的反应是否变得不稳定,我们认为,这是即将失败的更直接的信号。

blocks.en: We hypothesize that impending failure is preceded by measurable temporal instability. Stable operation produces smooth representation trajectories and consistent predictions, whereas emerging failure produces increasing representation drift, prediction oscillation, trajectory curvature, and attention uncertainty. Visual Tripwires uses these temporal signals to identify an emerging unreliable regime before the model crosses the predefined failure threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,在即将失败之前,会出现可衡量的时间不稳定。 稳定的运行产生平稳的表达轨迹和一致的预测,而新出现的失败则产生越来越多的表达漂移、预测振荡、轨迹曲率和注意力的不确定性。 Visual Tripwires利用这些时间信号在模型跨越预定义的故障阈值之前识别出一个新出现的不可靠的制度.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We introduce Visual Tripwires , a framework that predicts impending model failure from the temporal evolution of internal representations and predictions. Given the model history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} defined in Section 3 , we compute a set of instability signals, aggregate their recent values using a lightweight prediction network, and estimate the probability that the model will enter an unreliable state within the next Δ \Delta time steps. Figure 2 presents an overview of the framework.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Visual Tripwires, 一个从内部表达和预测的时间演化中预测即将发生的模型故障的框架. 鉴于第3节中定义的模型历史 H t\ mathcal{H}_{t},我们计算出一组不稳定信号,使用轻量级的预测网络来汇总它们最近的数值,并估计该模型在下一个\\Delta时间步骤中进入不可靠状态的概率. 图2概述了该框架。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Visual Tripwires for predictive failure estimation under progressive corruption and distribution shift. Given a temporally perturbed input sequence, the objective is to predict whether the model will enter an unreliable regime before degradation becomes observable in its outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价视网膜 Tripwires 在渐进式腐败和分配转变下预测故障估计。 鉴于时间上扰动的输入序列,目的是预测该模型是否会进入不可靠的系统,然后才能在其产出中观察到降解。

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C [ 10 ] , which extend CIFAR-10 [ 12 ] and ImageNet [ 1 ] with 15 corruption types at five severity levels. Because these benchmarks do not provide dense temporal sequences, we construct a trajectory for each clean image by interpolating corruption intensity across and beyond the benchmark severity levels. This produces a sequence X = { x 1 , … , x T } X=\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{T}\} with monotonically increasing severity. For discrete corruptions, such as JPEG compression, each severity level is held for T / 5 T/5 consecutive steps. Trajectories are generated independently for each corruption type, and results are averaged across corruptions unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C[10],后者扩展了CIFAR-10[12]和ImageNet[1],涉及15种严重腐败类型。 由于这些基准不能提供密集的时间序列,我们通过在基准严重性水平之间和之外插入腐败强度,为每一个干净的图像构建一个轨迹。 这产生了一个X={×1,...,×T}X××1},\ldots,x×T}的序列,其单调性越来越严重. 对于离散的腐败,如JPEG压缩,每个重度级为T / 5 T/5连续步. 每种腐败类型都独立产生轨迹,除非另有说明,否则在各种腐败中平均产生结果。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate on BDD100K [ 25 ] , which provides native temporal structure with variation in illumination, motion, and weather. Perturbations are applied along the existing temporal axis, providing a complementary evaluation under realistic changes in visual content.
blocks.zh: 我们还对BDD100K[25]进行额外评估,这为本地时间结构提供了照明、运动和天气的变化。 扰动沿着现有的时间轴进行,在视觉内容的现实变化下提供补充评价.

blocks.en: Training, validation, and test partitions are separated at the source-image or video-clip level to prevent correlated frames from appearing across splits. A subset of corruption types is excluded from training and evaluated separately to measure generalization to unseen distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 培训、验证和测试分区在源图像或视频-剪辑级别上分开,以防止在分裂之间出现相关帧。 某一类腐败类型被排除在培训和单独评估之外,以衡量普遍化到前所未有的分布变化。

blocks.en: 5.2 Architectures
blocks.zh: 5.2 建筑

blocks.en: We evaluate ResNet-50 [ 9 ] , ViT-B/16 [ 2 ] , and Swin-T [ 16 ] . Latent representations are extracted from the penultimate feature layer of ResNet-50 and the final CLS token embeddings of ViT-B/16 and Swin-T. For the transformer models, attention entropy is computed across all heads in the final layer. For ResNet-50, attention entropy is omitted and g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) is trained using the remaining three instability signals.
blocks.zh: 我们评价ResNet-50[9]、VIT-B/16[2]和Swin-T[16]。 从ResNet-50的倒数第二特征层和Vit-B/16和Swin-T的最终CLS符号嵌入中提取Latet表示. 对于变压器模型,注意力 en在最后一层的所有头部中计算. 对ResNet-50来说,注意的entropy被省略,g QQ (⋅) g(\cdot) 使用剩余的三个不稳定信号进行训练.

blocks.en: 5.3 Progressive Failure Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.3 逐步失败议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate Gaussian noise, motion blur, defocus blur, brightness variation, contrast degradation, JPEG compression, and structured occlusion. Perturbation severity increases monotonically with time, producing gradual degradation in visual quality and representation stability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价高斯噪音,运动模糊,分焦模糊,亮度变化,对比降解,JPEG压缩,以及结构化隔离. 扰动严重性随时间而单调增加,导致视觉质量和表现稳定性逐渐退化.

blocks.en: For classification tasks, failure is triggered when accuracy remains below 50 % 50\% for five consecutive time steps. For BDD100K, failure is triggered when the predicted class changes more than three times within a five-step window or when maximum softmax confidence falls below 0.4 0.4 . All thresholds are selected on the validation split and fixed during testing.
blocks.zh: 对于分类任务,当精确度连续5个时间步骤保持在50%/50+%以下时,就会触发失败. 对于BDD100K来说,当预测的类在五步窗口内发生3次以上变化或者当最大软马克斯置信度低于0.40.4 时,就会引发故障. 所有阈值在验证分拆上选择,并在测试中固定.

blocks.en: 5.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 5.4 基线

blocks.en: We compare Visual Tripwires with Maximum Softmax Probability [ 11 ] , Predictive Entropy [ 17 ] , Temperature Scaling [ 8 ] , Monte Carlo Dropout [ 3 ] , Deep Ensembles [ 13 ] , and ODIN [ 14 ] . These baselines evaluate reliability independently at each time step, whereas Visual Tripwires models instability over a trailing temporal window.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了视觉Tripwires和最大软马克思概率[11],预测Entropy [17],温度放大[8],蒙特 卡洛辍学 [3],深集[13],和ODIN[14]. 这些基线在每一时段都独立地评价可靠性,而Visual Tripwires则模拟了后期时间窗口的不稳定性。

blocks.en: 5.5 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.5 评价计量

blocks.en: We report AUROC, AUPRC, warning lead time, and false alarm rate on held-out test sequences. Lead time measures the number of steps between tripwire activation and failure and is reported only for sequences that contain a failure event. False alarm rate is the proportion of non-failing sequences in which the tripwire activates.
blocks.zh: 我们报告AUROC、AUPRC 警告准备时间 和暂停试验序列的假警报率 准备时间衡量绊线激活与故障之间的步骤数,只报告包含故障事件的序列. 假警报率是绊线激活的无故障序列的比例.

blocks.en: Each experiment is repeated over five runs with different random seeds and a fixed data split. Where available, results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation; otherwise, the mean across the five runs is reported. We use inverse-frequency class weighting in the binary cross-entropy loss to account for the imbalance between stable and future-failure windows.
blocks.zh: 每一个实验在5个以上重复进行,有不同的随机种子和固定数据分裂. 在有结果的情况下,报告结果为平均值±\pm标准差;否则,报告5次运行的平均值。 我们使用反频级加权法在二进制横切损失中计算出稳定窗口与未来故障窗口之间的不平衡.

blocks.en: 5.6 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 5.6 执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in PyTorch using publicly available pretrained checkpoints without finetuning on corrupted data. We use a sliding window of w = 5 w=5 , a prediction horizon of Δ = 10 \Delta=10 , and a sequence length of T = 100 T=100 , unless stated otherwise. The values of w w and Δ \Delta are selected through grid search on the validation split.
blocks.zh: 所有试验都是在PyTorch进行的,使用公开的预先训练的检查站,而不对损坏的数据进行微调。 我们使用滑动窗口为w=5w=5,预测视野为Q=10\德尔塔=10,序列长度为T=100T=100,除非另有说明. w w 和 \\ Delta 的值是通过在验证拆分上进行网格搜索来选择的.

blocks.en: The aggregation function g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) is trained using Adam with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and a batch size of 32 32 . The loss weights λ pred \lambda_{\mathrm{pred}} and λ temp \lambda_{\mathrm{temp}} , together with the decision threshold τ \tau , are selected on the validation split and fixed during testing. Experiments are conducted on NVIDIA 2080 Ti GPUs.
blocks.zh: 集合函数 g QQ( ) g( \ cdot) 使用 Adam 进行训练, 学习率为 10 - 4 10 QQ-4 ) , 批量大小为 32 32 。 损失权重 + pred\ lambda\ mathrm{ pred} 和 + 临时\ lambda\ mathrm{ temp} 连同决定阈值 \ tau , 在测试时在验证分中选择并固定 。 在NVIDIA 2080 Ti GPU上进行实验.

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: We evaluated visual tripwires across multiple architectures, datasets, and perturbation settings to assess whether temporal instability dynamics provides reliable early warning signals prior to predictive collapse. We compare our framework against standard uncertainty estimation and reliability baselines under progressive corruption and distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了跨越多个架构、数据集和扰动设置的视觉绊线,以评估时间不稳定动态是否在预测崩溃之前提供可靠的预警信号。 我们在逐步腐败和分配转移的情况下,将我们的框架与标准不确定性估计和可靠性基线进行比较。

blocks.en: 6.1 Failure Prediction Across Datasets
blocks.zh: 6.1 整个数据集的失败预测

blocks.en: We first evaluate failure prediction performance across multiple datasets and vision architectures. Table 1 reports AUROC and lead time under progressive perturbations. Visual Tripwires consistently outperform conventional uncertainty estimation methods across all datasets and architectures. In addition to achieving the highest AUROC, the proposed framework provides substantially larger lead time prior to failure events, demonstrating that instability in latent dynamics emerges before predictive degradation becomes observable.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估多个数据集和远景结构的故障预测性能。 表1报告了AUROC和渐进扰动下的周转时间。 在所有数据集和架构中,视觉Tripwires一直比传统的不确定性估计方法要好。 除了实现最高水平的AUROC之外,拟议框架在故障事件之前提供了大得多的准备时间,表明潜在动态的不稳定性在预测性退化出现之前就已经出现。

blocks.en: Table 1: Failure prediction performance across datasets and architectures.
blocks.zh: 表1:各数据集和结构的失败预测性能。

blocks.en: 6.2 Temporal Instability Emerges Before Failure
blocks.zh: 6.2 失败前的暂时不稳定性

blocks.en: We next analyze the temporal evolution of instability signals under progressive perturbations. Figure 3 visualizes representation drift, prediction oscillation, and tripwire scores together with model accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来分析不稳定信号在逐渐扰动下的时间演变。 图3可视化表示漂移,预测振荡,绊线计分与模型精度.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Temporal evolution of instability signals under progressive corruption. Instability dynamics and tripwire scores rise consistently before predictive degradation, providing early warning signals of impending failure.
blocks.zh: 图3:在逐步腐败下不稳定的瞬间演变迹象。 不稳定动力学和绊线分数在预测退化前持续上升,为即将失败提供预警信号。

blocks.en: Across all datasets, the instability signals increase before predictive degradation. In particular, prediction confidence often remains high while latent instability increases substantially, indicating that representation dynamics contain predictive information that is not captured by conventional uncertainty measures. We also observe increasing trajectory fragmentation as the severity of the perturbation increases, suggesting that predictive degradation is preceded by structural instability in the latent feature space.
blocks.zh: 在所有数据集中,不稳定信号在预测退化之前会增加。 特别是,预测信心往往很高,而潜在的不稳定性却大大增加,这表明代表动态包含的预测性信息不是常规不确定性措施所掌握。 我们还看到,随着扰动的严重程度增加,轨道破碎现象日益严重,这表明在预测性退化之前,潜在特征空间的结构不稳定。

blocks.en: 6.3 Case Study: Early Detection of Failure Under Progressive Occlusion
blocks.zh: 6.3 案例研究:在逐渐消失的情况下及早发现失败

blocks.en: To better understand the behaviour of Visual Tripwires in realistic settings, we analyze a representative failure trajectory from BDD100K under progressive visual occlusion. Figure 4 illustrates the evolution of prediction confidence, tripwire score, and model accuracy as occlusion severity increases over time.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解视觉 Tripwires在现实环境中的行为,我们在进步视觉闭塞下分析BDD100K的具有代表性的故障轨迹. 图4显示预测自信、绊线得分和模型精度的演变情况,因为隐蔽性的严重程度随时间推移而增加。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Case study under progressive visual occlusion. Prediction confidence remains high during the early stages of degradation, whereas tripwire scores increase substantially before predictive failure becomes observable.
blocks.zh: 图4:渐进视觉隔离的案例研究。 在退化的早期阶段,预测性信心仍然很高,而绊线分数在预测性故障出现前就大幅上升。

blocks.en: As occlusion severity increases, the model initially maintains high prediction confidence despite progressive degradation in latent representation stability. In contrast, the tripwire score rises steadily and activates approximately six time steps before the failure event.
blocks.zh: 随着隔离程度的提高,尽管潜在代表稳定性逐渐下降,该模型最初仍保持较高的预测信心。 相比之下,绊线得分稳步上升,并在故障事件前激活了大约6个时间步.

blocks.en: Notably, confidence based reliability measures remain largely unchanged until shortly before prediction accuracy deteriorates, whereas instability signals provide a substantially earlier indication of degradation. This behaviour suggests that latent representation dynamics contain predictive information about future failure that is not captured by conventional confidence estimates.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,在预测准确性恶化之前不久,基于信任的可靠性措施基本上保持不变,而不稳定信号则在很早以前就表明已退化。 这种行为表明,潜在的代表动态包含关于未来失败的预测性信息,而传统信任估计没有掌握这些信息。

blocks.en: These observations provide qualitative evidence for our central hypothesis that predictive failure emerges progressively through instability in representation geometry rather than as an instantaneous prediction error.
blocks.zh: 这些观察为我们的核心假设提供了质的证据,即预测性故障是通过代表几何的不稳定性逐步出现的,而不是作为瞬时的预测错误.

blocks.en: 6.4 Robustness Under Distribution Shift
blocks.zh: 6.4 分配移动时的强度

blocks.en: We further evaluate Visual Tripwires under unseen corruption types and out of distribution settings. Table 2 reports failure prediction performance under unseen perturbations.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价视网膜Tripwires 在隐形的腐败类型 和发行环境之外。 表2报告了在看不见的扰动下进行故障预测的情况。

blocks.en: Table 2: Failure prediction under unseen distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 表2:未见分布变化的预测失败。

blocks.en: Visual Tripwires consistently outperform uncertainty based baselines under unseen perturbations, achieving higher AUROC and lower false alarm rates. While conventional confidence measures often become unreliable under strong corruption, instability signals extracted from latent trajectories remain sensitive to structural degradation, enabling earlier and more robust failure detection.
blocks.zh: 视线Tripwires在未见扰动的情况下,一贯超越基于不确定性的基线,实现了较高的AUROC和较低的假警报率. 虽然在严重的腐败下,常规建立信任措施往往变得不可靠,但从潜在轨迹中提取的不稳定信号仍然对结构退化十分敏感,从而能够更早和更有力地发现故障。

blocks.en: 6.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 6.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We evaluate the contribution of each instability signal using a leave-one-component-out ablation. Each configuration is evaluated over five independent runs, and Table 3 reports the mean failure prediction AUROC and mean warning lead time across these runs.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个零星的断层来评估每个不稳定信号的影响。 每一个配置都经过5个独立运行评价,表3报告了平均故障预测AUROC和这些运行的平均警告准备时间。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation of individual instability signals. Results are averaged over five independent runs.
blocks.zh: 表3:个人不稳定信号的缩小。 平均结果为5次独立调查。

blocks.en: The full model achieves the highest mean AUROC and the longest mean warning lead time. Removing representation drift causes the largest performance reduction, decreasing AUROC by 0.08 and lead time by 2.1 steps. Removing prediction oscillation produces the second-largest reduction, followed by trajectory curvature and attention entropy. Performance declines whenever a component is removed, indicating that the four instability signals provide complementary information for anticipating predictive failure. Representation drift and prediction oscillation make the largest observed contributions under this evaluation.
blocks.zh: 全模型实现最高的平均值AUROC和最长的平均值警告准备时间. 消除代表漂移造成最大的性能下降,AUROC减少0.08,准备时间减少2.1步。 消除预测振荡产生第二大减速,其次是轨迹曲率和注意力率。 如果一个部件被移除,性能就会下降,这表明四个不稳定信号为预测失败提供了补充信息。 代表性漂移和预测振荡是本评价下观察到的最大贡献。

blocks.en: 6.6 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.6 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 5 provides a qualitative visualization of representation dynamics under progressive perturbations.
blocks.zh: 图5在渐进扰动下,对表现动态进行了定性可视化.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative analysis of Visual Tripwires under progressive perturbations. Stable operating regimes exhibit smooth latent trajectories and low tripwire scores, while impending failure is characterized by trajectory fragmentation and increasing instability signals.
blocks.zh: 图5:渐进扰动下的视觉三线线的定性分析. 稳定的操作系统呈现出平滑的潜在轨迹和低的绊线分数,而即将失败的特点是轨迹破碎和不稳定信号增加。

blocks.en: Stable operating regimes are associated with smooth and coherent latent trajectories. As perturbation severity increases, representation trajectories become increasingly fragmented, accompanied by rising tripwire scores. These qualitative observations are consistent with the quantitative results and support the hypothesis that predictive degradation is preceded by structural changes in latent representation geometry.
blocks.zh: 稳定的运作制度与平稳一致的潜在轨迹有关。 随着扰动严重性加剧,代表轨迹变得日益零散,并伴随着绊线分数上升. 这些定性观测结果与定量结果一致,支持预测性降解在潜在表达几何结构变化之前的假设.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Visual Tripwires , a predictive reliability framework that uses temporal changes in model behaviour to identify impending failures in deep vision systems. The framework combines representation drift, prediction oscillation, trajectory curvature, and attention entropy to detect emerging instability before a predefined failure event.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Visual Tripwires, 一个预测性可靠性框架, 它利用模型行为的时间变化来识别 即将在深度视觉系统中发生的故障。 框架结合了表示漂移,预测振荡,轨迹曲率,以及注意力py,在预先定义的失败事件发生前检测出新出现的不稳定性.

blocks.en: Experiments across CIFAR-10-C, ImageNet-C, and BDD100K demonstrate that Visual Tripwires consistently outperform confidence and uncertainty based baselines in failure prediction AUROC while providing longer warning lead times. The framework also remains effective under unseen distribution shifts, achieving higher detection performance and fewer false alarms. The ablation results show that each instability signal contributes to performance, with representation drift and prediction oscillation producing the largest observed gains. Together, these findings indicate that temporal changes in latent representations and predictions provide information about impending failure that is not fully captured by individual confidence estimates.
blocks.zh: 跨越CIFAR-10-C、ImageNet-C和BDD100K的实验表明,在预测AUROC的故障时,视觉Tripwire在提供较长的预警准备时间的同时,始终超过基于信心和不确定性的基线。 该框架在无形的分布转移下也依然有效,实现了更高的检测性能和较少的假警报. 衰减结果表明,每个不稳定信号都有助于性能,表现漂移和预测振荡产生最大的观测收益。 这些调查结果表明,潜在表述和预测的时间变化提供了即将发生的故障信息,而个人信心估计并未充分反映这些信息。

blocks.en: Future work will evaluate Visual Tripwires on dense prediction tasks, multimodal models, and naturally occurring distribution shifts. A further direction is to connect tripwire activation to adaptive responses, such as abstention, human review, input restoration, or dynamic model selection, enabling systems to act on early warnings before reliability deteriorates.
blocks.zh: 未来工作将评价关于密集预测任务、多式联运模型和自然发生的分布变化的视觉三线。 另一个方向是将绊线激活与适应性反应连接起来,如弃权、人体审查、输入恢复或动态模型选择,使系统能够在可靠性恶化之前就预警采取行动。

blocks.en: 7.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7.1 限制

blocks.en: Visual Tripwires require a temporally ordered sequence of inputs and may therefore be less suitable for isolated predictions without meaningful temporal or perturbation structure. Warning reliability may also decrease under abrupt domain transitions, where failure occurs before a sufficiently long instability trajectory can be observed, or in highly stochastic environments, where normal variation may resemble failure related instability.
blocks.zh: 视觉Tripwires需要按时间顺序进行输入,因此可能不太适合没有有意义的时间或扰动结构的孤立预测. 在突如其来的域过渡下,在能够观察到足够长的不稳定轨迹之前发生故障,或者在高度杂乱的环境中,正常变化可能类似于与故障有关的不稳定,警告的可靠性也可能下降。

blocks.en: The framework requires access to intermediate representations and, for attention based signals, internal attention maps. This limits direct application to closed source systems that expose only output probabilities or predicted labels. The current instability measures are manually specified and may not capture all forms of model degradation. Their thresholds may also require calibration when transferring the framework across architectures, datasets, or deployment conditions.
blocks.zh: 该框架要求查阅中间表述,对于基于关注的信号,则需要查阅内部关注图。 这限制了直接应用到只暴露输出概率或预测标签的封闭源系统. 目前的不稳定措施是人工确定的,可能无法捕捉所有形式的模式退化。 它们的阈值在将框架跨越结构、数据集或部署条件时也可能要求校准。

blocks.en: Finally, the evaluation primarily uses controlled corruptions and progressive perturbations. Although these settings enable precise measurement of failure onset and warning lead time, they do not represent the full complexity of deployment environments, where multiple shifts may occur simultaneously and failure boundaries may be ambiguous. Evaluation on naturally occurring temporal shifts and prospective deployment data is therefore required to establish practical generalization.
blocks.zh: 最后,评价主要使用受控制的腐败和渐进的干扰。 虽然这些设置能够精确地衡量故障发生和警告准备时间,但它们并不代表部署环境的全部复杂性,因为部署环境可能同时发生多次转移,故障界限可能模糊不清。 因此,需要对自然发生的时间变化和预期部署数据进行评价,以便确定实际的概况。
